Baseline.description: Immutable, content-addressed snapshot (I7). Computing it is PB27.
Baseline.title: Baseline

Claim.description:
An assertion. Its `basis` is not a field: it is the node's outgoing
`EVIDENCED_BY` / `DERIVED_FROM` edges, so there is one record of it. A
`Hypothesis` is a different node type, not a flavour of `Claim`.
Claim.title: Claim

Computed.description:
An output of a registered formula. `FormulaValidator` (PB11) recomputes
`value` from `input_ids` and diffs it.
Computed.title: Computed

Constraint.description:
Regulatory, contractual or policy obligation. Always sourced (I8): a
document and a locator, never an inference.
Constraint.title: Constraint

EvidenceKind.description: What sort of thing a piece of evidence is (docs/DESIGN.md §5.1).
EvidenceKind.title: EvidenceKind

EvidenceSpan.description:
A located extract: the atom of provenance (I1). `start` and `end` are
character offsets into the source's normalised text projection (the same
offsets `core.evidence.EvidenceSpan` uses), not raw file bytes; I1 is checked
by re-extracting the file and slicing at them.
EvidenceSpan.title: EvidenceSpan

FeatureIdea.description: May reference a `Need` (via ADDRESSES); a `Need` may never reference it (I3).
FeatureIdea.title: FeatureIdea

GraphLocator.description:
`core.evidence.Locator`, frozen. The ingest `Locator` is mutable, and a
node's locator must not change after its id was derived.
GraphLocator.title: GraphLocator

Input.description: A proposed or authored quantity. Never an output of arithmetic.
Input.title: Input

Need.description: A customer benefit, verb-first, in the customer's voice (I3).
Need.title: Need

Partition.description: Named scope area with a declared boundary (§12.2). `CLAIMED_BY` targets it.
Partition.title: Partition

Severity.description: How much authority a Finding carries (docs/DESIGN.md §9.1).
Severity.title: Severity

Source.description:
A raw ingested artifact. Holds no text and no absolute path: the file's
bytes are the source of record, and `graph.json` is portable.
Source.title: Source

Tier.description: How direct a piece of evidence is (docs/DESIGN.md §5.1).
Tier.title: Tier
